identity-comparison.title: Replace identity comparison
identity-comparison.description: Use == or != for value comparison instead of is or is not.

unsafe-eval.title: Use a safe literal parser
unsafe-eval.description: Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval() when only Python literals are expected.

infinite-loop.title: Bound a queue-processing loop
infinite-loop.description: Use while queue: when a loop removes items until the queue is empty.

missing-colon.title: Add the missing block colon
missing-colon.description: Add a colon after def, class, if, for, while, try, and related block headers.

literal-type-error.title: Convert incompatible literal values
literal-type-error.description: Convert literal operands to compatible strings before concatenation.
